title: Natan bar Shila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was chief of the butchers in Tzippori in Rabbi's time, as in [Chullin 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.50b.2) and [58b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.58b.8), and testified before Rabbi about two halakhot in Rabbi Natan's name. Hyman reports that Kaftor VaFerach, chapter 14, reads Rabbi Natan bar Shila.

notes.text: The addition of Rabbi to Natan’s name is the reading Hyman attributes to Kaftor VaFerach. The two halakhot are reported before Rabbi in another Rabbi Natan’s name.

At 50b, Rav Yehudah says in Rav’s name that Natan bar Shila testified before Rabbi in Rabbi Natan’s name. At 58b, Natan bar Shila again testifies before Rabbi, and the passage gives no source for that ruling. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2744&lang=en) associates “in Rabbi Natan’s name” with 50b.
